# Season page fixtures

Real inputs, captured 2026-09-27, that the season page's episode chips are tested against
(`src/utils/tvEpisodes.test.ts`, `src/test/pages/show-episode-chips.client.test.tsx`).
Every request is one the season page itself makes, sent to production the way the page sends
it; nothing here is hand-written. `src/test/utils/seasonFixtures.ts` replays them in the order
the page merges them.

Five seasons, chosen for what each one exercises:

| Season                         | Why                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Spy x Family S3 (`tt13706018`) | Anime with AniDB entries. Groups number by the whole run as well as by season: `S03E46` and `- 38` are the season's 9th and 1st, and `S01 - 24` / `Season 2 - 27` are other seasons. |
| Frieren S1 (`tt22248376`)      | Anime whose first season is numbered `- 05`, `E5`, `[EP01-12]` and `(01-28) [Batch]`, next to doujin archives filed under the same key.                                              |
| South Park S29 (`tt0121955`)   | Airing: one episode out, five scheduled (`next_episode_to_air` is S29E02).                                                                                                           |
| Friends S10 (`tt0108778`)      | Western, full of multi-episode names: `S10E17-E18`, `s10e17e18`, `S10.E17-18`, `s10e1-8`, `10x18`, `Ep 07-12`, `全17集`, plus other shows filed under season ten.                    |
| The Office S4 (`tt0386676`)    | Western: `S04E01E02`, `4x11`, disc packs (`S04D01`), `Temporada 4 [Cap.401_404]`, and another show's `S04E22`.                                                                       |

| File                           | Source                                                                                                                                                                                      | Kept as received?                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dmm-tv-<imdb>-s<season>.json` | `GET /api/torrents/tv?imdbId=…&seasonNum=…&onlyTrusted=false&maxSize=0&page=N` with a `/api/challenge` token, page 0 up to the first empty page                                             | Yes, every page body in order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `addons-<imdb>-s<season>.json` | Torrentio and Peerflix, `…/realdebrid=real-debrid-key/stream/series/<imdb>:<season>:<episode>.json`, walked the way `fetchData` walks them (two episodes at a time until two empty batches) | Per stream, only the fields `transformExternalStream` reads (`name`, `title`, `description`, `infoHash`, `fileIdx`, `url`, `behaviorHints.filename/videoSize/bingeGroup`), values unchanged. `url` is dropped where `infoHash` or `bingeGroup` carries the same hash, the fallback the transform takes, so its output is identical. Comet, MediaFusion and TorrentsDB need a user's key and were not asked. |
| `info-show-<imdb>.json`        | `GET /api/info/show?imdbid=…`                                                                                                                                                               | Yes. `tt0096697` (The Simpsons, next episode S38E01) is here for the not-yet-started case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `anime-by-imdb-<imdb>.json`    | `GET /api/anime/by-imdb?imdbids=…`                                                                                                                                                          | Yes. A show with entries is what the page treats as anime.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `usenet-<imdb>-s<season>.json` | `GET /api/nzb2rd/search?imdbId=…&seasonNum=…&title=…`                                                                                                                                       | Titles, sizes, `isPack`, `pubDate` and `category` as received. Each indexer-qualified `id` is replaced with `usenet-<n>` and `indexer` is removed: together they would name the upstream indexers, which this public repository must not.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `corpus-shows.json`            | `GET /api/info/show` and `GET /api/anime/by-imdb` for the eighteen shows in `../season-titles.json`                                                                                         | `title`, `season_count` and `season_episode_counts` from the first, and the second's entries, per show. Lets the season-pack corpus be read with each show's real episode counts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
